name: morning-brief
description: A morning brief from the user's connected work tools — to-dos owed today, verified against each source's latest state, news they would otherwise miss, one piece of work to push forward, and today's calendar — in the user's language, saved as dated JSON and markdown for downstream automation

output_dir.title: Output directory
output_dir.description: Absolute path where each brief's JSON and markdown are written; leave empty to use the plugin's data directory

language.title: Brief language
language.description: Language of the brief, e.g. ko or en; leave empty to use the language the session answers in
